![][image1]**Slide 3 — Opportunity / Problem Statement (Winning Version)**

**On-slide bullets (keep it clean & visual):**

* 62% of U.S. nurses report burnout; 1 in 4 plan to leave

* Turnover cost: \~$56K per nurse; $9B annually to hospitals.   
* Each 1% drop in turnover saves $2.6M annually in a 1,000-nurse hospital

* ICU PTSD rates: up to 50% of staff

* Current solutions (apps, EAPs, workshops) \= too long, delayed, or off-shift

* Gap: no **real-time, in-shift nervous system training**

---

**Spoken Script (\~45s):**

“Every shift, clinicians face dozens of gap moments—the 30 to 60 seconds before intubation, during a handoff, or between cases—when stress either clears or embeds as trauma. Right now, over **62% of nurses report burnout**, and **one in four plan to leave**. Each nurse lost costs hospitals about **$56,000**, adding up to more than **$9 billion every year**.

In the ICU, as many as **half of staff show PTSD symptoms**. And what’s available? Meditation apps that take 20 minutes, employee assistance programs that intervene only after harm, or resilience workshops that happen off the floor. None of these help in the moment when stress actually spikes.

That’s the gap: clinicians have **no standard, in-shift mental hygiene practice** to protect their nervous systems where it matters most. And that is exactly the opportunity Pausality is built to solve.”

---

✅ Why this wins:

2. **Data \+ emotion:** Burnout %, turnover $, PTSD prevalence.

3. **Failure of current solutions:** Judges immediately see the white space.

4. **Language:** “Gap moments → trauma or resilience” \= sticky and sets up your unique angle.

5. **Time discipline:** Fits in 40–45s so you can move to your solution.
